why: The answer depends on the anatomy of the gut - the sphincter of Oddi guards the opening of the common hepatopancreatic duct into the duodenum, the ileocaecal valve and pyloric sphincter guarding other junctions.
note: Topic gap, not a chapter gap: Digestion and Absorption carries only 'Dentition and Types of Teeth' and 'Digestive Secretions and Their Enzymes', with no 'Unspecified Topic' placeholder, so the gross anatomy of the alimentary canal has no row - although the sphincter of Oddi is in the NCERT chapter text (verified at ncert BIO11O ch16 p007). Other rows this chapter needs: 'Human Digestive System: Alimentary Canal', 'Digestive Glands (Liver, Pancreas, Salivary)', 'Digestion of Carbohydrates, Proteins and Fats', 'Absorption and Assimilation', 'Disorders of the Digestive System'.
proposed_topic: Human Digestive System: Alimentary Canal and Associated Glands
